g.title: CITransNet takes three inputs bidding profile bidder-contexts item-contexts
g.desc: CITransNet takes three inputs: the bidding profile, bidder-contexts, and item-contexts.

g.title: final layer outputs allocations payments zero-regret enforced training
g.desc: A final layer outputs allocations and payments, with zero-regret enforced during training.

g.title: embeds contexts bids representation per bidder-item pair transformer interaction layers global average row column permutation-equivariant
g.desc: It embeds contexts with bids into a representation per bidder-item pair, then passes it through transformer interaction layers that mix a global average with row and column transformers, staying permutation-equivariant.

g.text: Global average + row + column transformers — permutation-equivariant.
